entities.name: Nitrobenzothiazole
observations: The substrate decodes as O=[N+]([O-])c1ccc2ncsc2c1, a nitro-substituted benzothiazole.
The nitro substituent is reduced to an amino group under SnCl2/basic workup while the fused heterocycle remains intact.

entities.name: Aminobenzothiazole
observations: The predicted product is Nc1ccc2ncsc2c1, the amino-substituted benzothiazole corresponding to reduction of the starting nitro group.

entities.name: SnCl2 basic reduction
observations: SnCl2 reduces the aromatic nitro group to a primary aromatic amine; NaOH is consistent with basic workup and chloride/sodium ions are spectators.
